reviews.title: Unstable on iOS
reviews.text: I used to love this app, bought it a long time ago. It is almost completely unusable on iPhone. The patch feature to draw in level of depth of bokeh with color is completely unstable. I can’t zoom in correctly not without it glitching out, the brush disappears if you zoom in. You have to draw zoomed out and cannot get dialed in details. Was once one of the best bokeh creating apps on the market, unfortunately became one of the worst. Will change my rating once they get it fixed, but I won’t hold my breath. This has been a problem now for years.

reviews.title: Scammy subscription?
reviews.text: Something has gone wrong with this app, which I remember thinking was quite reputable some years ago. But I was astonished on latest download to find it absolutely crippled for use, unless I paid —no kidding, — $9.99 every WEEK.  You read that correctly, every WEEK. Why would a developer have such a pricing as their default? I don’t know, but one possibility is that their new business plan includes hoping that people forget to cancel their weekly subscription after the first few days. Just a guess. (Yes, there is a $99 per year subscription plan, but nothing reasonable by the month.  And $99 per year is also an astonishingly high price for an app that isn’t handling your entire workflow.) All in all, this bizarre pricing makes me worry that the developer has perhaps been bought out by some predatory firm. I don’t know that to be the case, I am just suspicious that where there is smoke there is fire. So I will not give them any of my data, or any access privileges on my phone.

If not fixed, I’ll be deleting.

reviews.title: Bad upgrade
reviews.text: I used to LOVE this app. It was so user friendly and had a great auto recognition system for the main focus of pictures. Now, it struggles selecting the whole subject, cutting off noses, hair, hands, half of bodies. And the edit tool doesn’t work when the photo is zoomed in. So small details are lost and the photo edits look unnatural. It’s so disappointing.

reviews.title: The app has gotten worse.
reviews.text: The app has gotten worse. Two years ago, more features were free, and they worked better. Now, the blurring looks bad. Plus, you can't save a photo for free, even if you haven't used the paid features. Subscription prices are incredibly high, and there's no one-time purchase. I'd rather watch 10 ads in a row. And there's no basic option to manually select the background you want to blur yourself by using brush, which is really weird.

reviews.title: Started out awesome
reviews.text: I loved this app for many many years and used it regularly. Within the last 6 months it’s had so many bugs. I can’t use the patch tool which I used all the time. The brush tool is brushing the mask on in a completely different area than where I’m touching on my screen. It also will not zoom in properly on the image. It used to zoom in nicely and you could clean up the patch tool with ease. It’s so frustrating!
